confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and comparable Chinese cities; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because summer demand and tax/fee presentation vary by platform, and the estimates assume July peak-season pricing. Cocktail and wine were estimated from direct knowledge and sanity-checked against the beer anchor. The FX observation comes from RBA page excerpts returned by search; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: second-tier mainland Chinese tourist cities such as Chengdu, Xi'an and Wuhan, adjusted for Chongqing's central-city hotel and hostel supply and its hot-pot and street-food restaurant pricing.
